sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "locations"."COUNTRY_ID" AS e, "regions"."REGION_NAME" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "locations" JOIN "countries" ON "countries"."COUNTRY_ID" = "locations"."COUNTRY_ID" JOIN "regions" ON "regions"."REGION_ID" = "countries"."REGION_ID" GROUP BY "locations"."COUNTRY_ID", "regions"."REGION_NAME"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
